q: How many pesos did Lencho ask for in his letter to God?
e: Lencho asked for 100 pesos to sow his field again after his corn crop was ruined by hail.

q: How many pesos was the generous postmaster able to collect and send to Lencho?
e: The postmaster could only collect a little more than half, exactly 70 pesos, signed 'God'.

q: Lencho called the post office employees a 'bunch of crooks' because:
e: Lencho received only 70 pesos instead of 100 and suspected the post office employees took the rest.
